ceiling: Configuration validation only, so it confirms a selection scope, sampling seed and the exhaustive-claim flag are declared; it does not sample mutants.
offer: Make mutant sampling reproducible and state the selected scope. A sampled run may estimate sensitivity, but it cannot claim exhaustive mutation coverage.

minimal.reason: State the scope the sample is drawn from. An unscoped sample cannot be reproduced, so name the files or modules.

mid.reason: Record the sampling seed, at least 42 as a fixed value. A random draw cannot be rerun, so fix the seed.

maximal.reason: Set claiming exhaustive coverage from a sample to false. A sample estimates sensitivity only, so state it as a sample.

rule.reason: State the scope the sample is drawn from. An unscoped sample cannot be reproduced, so name the files or modules.
